description: Intent i012 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=af-packet-tpacket-rings) complete. Bounded audit of net/packet/af_packet.c in snapshots/s03 for the seed's check-then-use double-fetch invariant on the user-mapped TPACKET TX ring. ONE LOW-CONFIDENCE FINDING reported: net/packet/af_packet.c:2887-2896 (tpacket_snd) — tp_status is fetched for validation at 2795-2796 (packet_current_frame(..., TP_STATUS_SEND_REQUEST) -> packet_lookup_frame:528 status != __packet_get_status(...) -> __packet_get_status:439-446 READ_ONCE(h.hN->tp_status) on the mmap'd ring) and independently re-fetched at 2891 (__packet_get_status(po, ph)); the second value drives kernel skb-lifetime state (TP_STATUS_AVAILABLE => skb = NULL and out_status, else err = 0 and the loop treats the qdisc-owned skb as gone). This is the only same-field double fetch of shared-memory metadata found in s03's tpacket consumer path and matches the seed's shape, but its impact is unproven: tracing both race directions statically showed only benign accounting/ownership skew (packet_inc_pending at 2884 stays balanced by packet_dec_pending in tpacket_destruct_skb), no OOB access, double free, or UAF identified — hence low confidence. Strong non-candidates with concrete source evidence: tpacket_parse_header (2664-2715) single-fetches tp_len into a local and validates/returns the same local; tp_mac/tp_net offsets likewise single-fetched, bounds-checked at 2708, used at 2714; tpacket_snd's virtio_net_hdr is memcpy'd ONCE into a stack local at 2830 and both validation (__packet_snd_vnet_parse:2531-2545) and consumption (2835-2836, 2875, 2879) use the local copy — exactly the seed's fix pattern; tpacket_fill_skb (2570-2648) consumes only validated parameters; tpacket_rcv (2405-2465) is kernel->user writes only. Unresolved: skb_zcopy_set_nouarg(skb, ph.raw) at 2589 stores the user-shared frame pointer as a zcopy cookie; its clear/consume path in include/linux/skbuff.h was not line-verified (distinct bug class anyway). Limitations: only net/packet consumer path line-audited (ring setup setsockopt and prb_* TPACKET_V3 block-retire helpers grep-surveyed only); no build/reproducer run (read-only tree); only s03 searched.
